title: BlitzTag
tagline: As a newcomer to Web3, building my first OnchainKit component application, BlitzTag, has been an incredible experience! 🚀 BlitzTag leverages OnchainKit components like Identity, Transaction, and Wallet
description: As a newcomer to Web3, building my first OnchainKit component application, BlitzTag, has been an incredible experience! 🚀 BlitzTag leverages OnchainKit components like Identity, Transaction, and Wallet. After logging in with the Onchain wallet, users navigate to a page to select right or wrong answers, earning rewards minted as NFTs! 🎉✨
